newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Anglogold June quarter profit slips.
newsitem.headline: Anglogold June quarter profit slips.

text.p: Anglo American Corp of South Africa Ltd said on Thursday that available profits from from its gold mines fell to 220.7 million rand in the June quarter, down two percent on the preceding three months.
The world's biggest gold producer said output rose by one percent to 50,934 kg but revenue per kg was down by one percent at 52,649 rand.

Unit working costs were one percent lower at 44,442 rand per kg and total working costs only slightly higher at 2,263.6 million rand. Capital expenditure for the quarter was 24.5 million higher at 177.8 million.
Chief executive Bobby Godsell said that Anglogold companies had turned in "good" financial and "reasonable" operating results in the context of a weak and weakening gold price.
